newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: INSTANT VIEW-Portugal CPI falls 0.3 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW-Portugal CPI falls 0.3 pct in June.

text.p: The following is a series of analysts' reaction to news that Portugal's consumer price index (CPI) fell 0.3 percent month-on-month in June.

"It is a good number that is better than the most optimistic expectations and shows that there was an inversion of the trend (in May) of rises in meat and potato prices. This number supports the steepening of the (yield) curve, giving great support to the shorter bond yields."

"All the sectors were below expectations, and the Bank of Portugal did the right thing on Friday (cutting interest rates). I do not see a big (market) impact. There will only be further cuts in Bank of Portugal rates in September after the July and August inflation numbers confirm the (downwards) trend."
"The inflation in June is excellent. The number will be more positive for the debt market than for the share market which has been discounting the trend (lower inflation and lower interest rates)."

"It is a very good number that confirms the downwards trend in inflation. (It) makes room for further interest rate cuts, even if after Friday's move, I think that the Bank of Portugal will not cut again until around September."
